    11  /-!
    12  
    13  # Vector-valued measures
    14  
    15  This file defines vector-valued measures, which are σ-additive functions from a set to an
    16  additive monoid `M` such that it maps the empty set and non-measurable sets to zero. In the case
    17  that `M = ℝ`, we called the vector measure a signed measure and write `SignedMeasure α`.
    18  Similarly, when `M = ℂ`, we call the measure a complex measure and write `ComplexMeasure α`
    19  (defined in `MeasureTheory/Measure/Complex`).
    20  
    21  ## Main definitions
    22  
    23  * `MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure` is a vector-valued, σ-additive function that maps the empty
    24    and non-measurable sets to zero.
    25  * `MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.map` is the pushforward of a vector measure along a function.
    26  * `MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.restrict` is the restriction of a vector measure on some set.
    27  
    28  ## Notation
    29  
    30  * `v ≤[i] w` means that the vector measure `v` restricted on the set `i` is less than or equal
    31    to the vector measure `w` restricted on `i`, i.e. `v.restrict i ≤ w.restrict i`.
    32  
    33  ## Implementation notes
    34  
    35  We require all non-measurable sets to be mapped to zero in order for the extensionality lemma
    36  to only compare the underlying functions for measurable sets.
    37  
    38  We use `HasSum` instead of `tsum` in the definition of vector measures in comparison to `Measure`
    39  since this provides summability.
    40  
    41  ## Tags
    42  
    43  vector measure, signed measure, complex measure
    44  -/
    45  
    46  @[expose] public section
    47  
    48  
    49  noncomputable section
    50  
    51  open NNReal ENNReal Filter
    52  
    53  open scoped Topology Function -- required for scoped `on` notation
    54  namespace MeasureTheory
    55  
    56  variable {α β : Type*} {m : MeasurableSpace α}
    57  
    58  /-- A vector measure on a measurable space `α` is a σ-additive `M`-valued function (for some `M`
    59  an additive monoid) such that the empty set and non-measurable sets are mapped to zero. -/
    60  structure VectorMeasure (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M]
    61      [TopologicalSpace M] where
    62    /-- The measure of sets -/
    63    measureOf' : Set α → M
    64    /-- The empty set has measure zero -/
    65    empty' : measureOf' ∅ = 0
    66    /-- Non-measurable sets have measure zero -/
    67    not_measurable' ⦃i : Set α⦄ : ¬MeasurableSet i → measureOf' i = 0
    68    /-- The measure is σ-additive -/
    69    m_iUnion' ⦃f : ℕ → Set α⦄ : (∀ i, MeasurableSet (f i)) → Pairwise (Disjoint on f) →
    70      HasSum (fun i => measureOf' (f i)) (measureOf' (⋃ i, f i))
    71  
    72  /-- A `SignedMeasure` is an `ℝ`-vector measure. -/
    73  abbrev SignedMeasure (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] :=
    74    VectorMeasure α ℝ
    75  
    76  open Set
    77  
    78  namespace VectorMeasure
    79  
    80  section
"}]
